packs.goal: 修复 RV04，建立最小正式候选数据验证/发现基线，先独立验收再消费。仅实现 W1 所需有限类型、版本、来源、条件、关系/绑定/状态约束；不复制整个固定试点为通用生产引擎。
acceptance: RV04: deep freeze private qualification/profile + detach all returned public objects; mutate prior result source/edge/anchor/example or profile then repeat query unchanged; retain all185 checks and actual frozen nested replay.

Define human-readable per-owner candidate pack plus separate source-specific evidence qualification; exact file/content/anchor identity, revision, actual L1 D4 owner coverage, case F+/F-/R+/R- and conditions, typed H/O closure and inverse; candidate vs accepted evidence explicit; reject missing/dangling/invalid/duplicate/self-support/condition/authority, stale versions, coordinated removal, arbitrary source admission and leak; no runtime self-sealing.

Use small synthetic/candidate examples only; no formal K01/K07 population or accepted claims. Validate new fields/families with concrete negatives; scope limits recorded. Required affected independent review resolves RV04 and minimum common validation before formal batches.
